stories.title: Dog walkers in Flintshire face another three years of rules on where their pets can go, as the council moves to renew its public space orders before they expire in October.

stories.title: Wales imprisons more people than England and most of Western Europe, MPs say
stories.summary: Wales imprisons more of its population than England and most of Western Europe, and MPs are calling for a review to find out why. stories.title: RSPCA urges new Welsh Government to deliver animal welfare manifesto pledges
stories.summary: RSPCA Cymru is urging the new Welsh Government to deliver on Plaid Cymru’s animal welfare manifesto pledges in an open letter to the rural affairs minister. stories.title: Connah’s Quay power station project moves to decision stage as examination ends
stories.summary: The six-month examination of Uniper’s plans for a new carbon capture power station at Connah’s Quay has closed, moving the project into its decision stage.
